outputs.explanation: The lower graph in panel A is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of HMGB1 signal intensity (Nuc/Cyto) across genotypes, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars despite N=4, n>100 samples being used.
The lower graph in panel B is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of the percentage of aggregate-positive Purkinje cells (N=4, n>400), but individual data points are not shown.
Panel C is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data; the check does not apply.
Panel D is a line plot (time on rotarod vs. week) with error bars; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel E consists of line plots (time on rotarod across days for different ages) with error bars; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve, a type of line plot; individual data points are not required for this plot type.
Panel G shows micrograph images (immunofluorescence of cerebellar tissue), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel H contains two bar charts (molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number) presented as mean ± SD across N=3 mice/n=9 fields, but individual data points are not overlaid on the bars.
